cohort: The study included 223,099 schoolchildren born in Denmark between 1930 and 1989, linked to national health registers.
finding: The risk of adult type 2 diabetes was not statistically associated with month or season of birth in this large Danish population-based study.
followup_time: Individuals were followed from 1977 or age 30 years until diagnosis, death, or the end of the study (implied around 2015), with some individuals followed up to 85 years of age.
birth_weight: N/A (birthweight categories were used in a sub-analysis, but specific weights for the included cohort are not given as an inclusion criterion)
